Commentary: Australia Squad: Mitchell Marsh(c), Jake Fraser-McGurk, Sam Harper(w), Nikhil Chaudhary, Tim David, Lachlan Shaw, Joel Davies, Jack Edwards, Ben Dwarshuis, Adam Zampa, Riley Meredith, Billy Stanlake, Henry Thornton, Spencer Johnson, Mitchell Owen

England Squad: Philip Salt, Aneurin Donald, Harry Brook(c), Tom Banton, James Coles, Sam Curran, Jordan Cox(w), Liam Dawson, Jamie Overton, Adil Rashid, Henry Crocombe, Luke Wood, Will Jacks, Eddie Jack, Thomas Rew
Squads:

Sam Curran to Fraser-McGurk, SIX, that has been dispatched. What a strike. On the shorter side around off, Jake Fraser-McGurk stays put in the crease and simply spanks it over long-on. Right over the boundary for half-a-dozen.. That was a stylish hit by the batsman
Sam Curran to Fraser-McGurk, 1 run, touch fuller around middle and leg, squeezed towards mid-on for a single
Sam Curran to Sam Harper, 1 run, yorker length ball around off, squeezed towards mid-off for a single

Sam Curran to Fraser-McGurk, SIX, another fantastic shot! Just Jake Fraser-McGurk things! This was on the shorter side around middle and leg, Jake Fraser-McGurk picks the length early and swipes it over deep square leg. Perfect pick up shot and this one went miles up. Right into the second tier as one of the spectators takes it in the stands
Liam Dawson [1.0-0-7-1] is back into the attack
Liam Dawson to Sam Harper, THATS OUT!! Caught!!

Liam Dawson to Sam Harper, out Caught by Jamie Overton!! End of Sam Harper's cameo. He has played a couple of similar cameos in his short T20I career so far. He hasn't been able to convert these starts into substantial scores. Still early days, so he will only learn and get better. This was a flatter delivery by Liam Dawson, fraction short, Sam Harper takes the aerial route, but he has been caught at mid-on. Overton with his second catch of the innings, ran towards his left and completed the formalities. Sam Harper c Jamie Overton b Liam Dawson 26(14) [4s-1 6s-3]
Nikhil Chaudhary, right handed bat, comes to the crease
Liam Dawson to Nikhil Chaudhary, no run, tossed up delivery around off, driven towards cover by Nikhil Chaudhary
Liam Dawson to Nikhil Chaudhary, no run, flatter through the air at the stumps, blocked from within the crease
Liam Dawson to Nikhil Chaudhary, FOUR, swept away! Off the mark is Nikhil Chaudhary. Goes down on his knee and finds the deep backward square leg fence with this well executed sweep
Liam Dawson to Nikhil Chaudhary, 1 run, on a length at the pads, nudged towards the on-side for a single

Liam Dawson to Fraser-McGurk, FOUR, he's trying to make the most of the powerplay. This was a tossed up delivery around leg, Jake Fraser-McGurk flicks it towards the long-on fence and adds four more to the tally. Australia - 64/2 after 6
Jamie Overton, right-arm fast, comes into the attack
Jamie Overton to Nikhil Chaudhary, 1 run, on a length around leg, Nikhil Chaudhary uses his wrists to whip it towards wide long-on
Jamie Overton to Fraser-McGurk, THATS OUT!! Caught!!

Jamie Overton to Fraser-McGurk, out Caught by Tom Banton at long-on!! Jake Fraser-McGurk departs right after the powerplay. Jamie Overton comes into the attack and gets the set batsman. A wicket for him in his first over. This was pitched up by the pacer and Jake Fraser-McGurk took him on. Takes the aerial route and lofts it towards long-on, but it's a comfortable catch for Banton in the deep. He didn't have to move an inch. Australia are scoring runs at a brisk rate, however, England are striking back at regular intervals. Fraser-McGurk c Tom Banton b Jamie Overton 22(11) [4s-1 6s-2]
Tim David, right handed bat, comes to the crease
Jamie Overton to Tim David, no run, on a length around off, knocked in front of cover from within the crease
Jamie Overton to Tim David, 1 run, pitched up by the bowler around middle and leg, driven down the ground to long-on
Jamie Overton to Nikhil Chaudhary, leg byes, 1 run, ouch! That has hit him right onto the helmet. 142 kph by Jamie Overton as he went short at the body. Nikhil Chaudhary
STAT: England are the first side to bowl four overs of spin in the powerplay at the Gabba in a T20I. Afghanistan bowled three against Sri Lanka at the 2022 T20 World Cup.
